# Inputs

Inputs become the script's settings form. Declare them at the top level; each call returns the value the user chose.

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`input.int()`](#input-int) | A whole-number setting; the value is rounded. |
| [`input.float()`](#input-float) | A decimal-number setting. |
| [`input.bool()`](#input-bool) | An on/off setting (a checkbox). |
| [`input.select()`](#input-select) | One of a fixed list of strings (a drop-down). |
| [`input.string()`](#input-string) | A free-text setting. |
| [`input.source()`](#input-source) | A price source chosen by the user (TradingView's `input.source`); returns the bar-aligned series. |
| [`input.color()`](#input-color) | A colour chosen by the user, as a CSS colour string (`#rrggbb` or `rgba(...)`). |

### input.int() {#input-int}

```ts
input.int(name: string, defaultValue: number, options?: NumberInputOptions): number
```

A whole-number setting; the value is rounded. `name` is its label and its key in saved settings.

Types: [NumberInputOptions](#numberinputoptions)

### input.float() {#input-float}

```ts
input.float(name: string, defaultValue: number, options?: NumberInputOptions): number
```

A decimal-number setting.

Types: [NumberInputOptions](#numberinputoptions)

### input.bool() {#input-bool}

```ts
input.bool(name: string, defaultValue: boolean, options?: InputMeta): boolean
```

An on/off setting (a checkbox).

Types: [InputMeta](#inputmeta)

### input.select() {#input-select}

```ts
input.select<T extends string>(name: string, defaultValue: T, options: readonly T[], meta?: InputMeta): T
```

One of a fixed list of strings (a drop-down).

Types: [InputMeta](#inputmeta)

### input.string() {#input-string}

```ts
input.string(name: string, defaultValue: string, options?: InputMeta): string
```

A free-text setting.

Types: [InputMeta](#inputmeta)

### input.source() {#input-source}

```ts
input.source(name: string, defaultValue?: Source, options?: InputMeta): Series
```

A price source chosen by the user (TradingView's `input.source`); returns the bar-aligned series.

Types: [Source](#source), [InputMeta](#inputmeta), [Series](./series#series)

### input.color() {#input-color}

```ts
input.color(name: string, defaultValue: string, options?: InputMeta): string
```

A colour chosen by the user, as a CSS colour string (`#rrggbb` or `rgba(...)`).

Types: [InputMeta](#inputmeta)

## Types

### InputMeta {#inputmeta}

Shared by every input: a heading in the settings form, a hover hint, and a key that puts inputs on one row.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `group?` | `string` |  |
| `tooltip?` | `string` |  |
| `inline?` | `string` |  |

### NumberInputOptions {#numberinputoptions}

Bounds and step of a number input in the settings form.

`NumberInputOptions extends InputMeta`

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `min?` | `number` |  |
| `max?` | `number` |  |
| `step?` | `number` |  |

### Source {#source}

A price source for `input.source()`: a candle field, an average of them, candle volume or the moving price.

```ts
type Source = "open" | "high" | "low" | "close" | "hl2" | "hlc3" | "ohlc4" | "hlcc4" | "volume" | "movingPrice"
```
